people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king, to conduct him over the Jordan.
translations.bsb: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and send him on his way from there.
translations.kjv: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
translations.asv: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king, to conduct him over the Jordan.
